snippet.title: Professional Money Relocator Trailer
snippet.description:
So much wealth is cluttering up this place! Enjoy a relaxing, satisfying collectathon where you clear out a massive vault. Pack loot into your bag and upgrade your gear to claim every valuable. There is nothing quite like the sound of crisp bills filling your pockets.
